svg.title: Routing becomes a distribution over path lengths
svg.desc: Exact terminal hitting laws. Upper-panel blue circles denote direct routing and vermillion squares the chain. Lower-panel lines join discrete path probabilities for the first predeclared realization of each ten-node family; they are not fitted probability densities.
